environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.65 on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), PostgreSQL 14.6 RDS instance in same VPC. Application deployed behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. RDS security group allows inbound 5432 from application SG. DB user 'appuser' has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on schema 'inventory'. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and Tomcat.

config.db_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on inventory.*
